article.title: Lead Munitions Detonation in Middletown, IA
article.author: Quad Cities DSA
article.content: This Friday, November 20th, the US Army will detonate barrels of unstable explosive lead azide at the Iowa Army Ammunition Plant outside of Middletown, IA, creating a plume of toxic lead dust that will move 100 miles north towards the Quad Cities and blanket hundreds of square miles of Iowa and Illinois.
